name: filament-date-time-slots
description: A powerful Filament form component for scheduling future appointments, tasks, and reservations with configurable calendars, working hours, available and blocked time slots, minimum lead time, timezone support, and 12/24-hour display modes.

paragraphs: A polished date and time slot picker for Filament forms. Build booking, appointment, reservation, task, and scheduling workflows with configurable calendars, working hours, availability rules, blocked slots, timezones, and responsive layouts.
features: Calendar-based date selection with configurable minimum and maximum dates.
Generate slots from weekly working hours or provide exact slots for each date.
Mark booked slots as unavailable, with an option to show them in the picker.
Configure slot intervals and minimum lead time for advance booking rules.
Disable past dates and past slots automatically.

whatItDoes.text: A polished date and time slot picker for Filament forms. Build booking, appointment, reservation, task, and scheduling workflows with configurable calendars, working hours, availability rules, blocked slots, timezones, and responsive layouts.
